title: API memory limit too low
reason: Diagnosis accurately points to the API container, describes the memory/OOM problem, and cites the reduced memory limit as the trigger.
option_titles: Restore API memory limit and restart
Temporarily restart API to restore service
root_cause: The API container's memory limit was reduced from 512 MiB to 150 MiB, causing the Python app to exceed the limit and be OOM‑killed (exit code 137) on each start.
truth: Someone lowered the api container's memory limit from 512MiB to 150MiB, below its normal working set of ~180MiB, so the kernel OOM killer repeatedly terminates it (exit code 137).
